title: chat-server: refresh stale unreadCount spec quotes
description: jmap-chat-spec aa01dd7 (bead vz8p) landed: unreadCount candidates are messages after lastReadMessageId (all if absent), and which candidates count is implementation-defined; servers MAY exclude the owner's own messages; unreadReplyCount follows the same rule. Behavior of unread_count already matches. Update crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs unread_count doc comment (~L400), which calls vz8p 'pending', to cite the landed text; update the quoted old draft text ('all messages are counted as unread') in crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/expiry_sweep.rs (~L30). Comment-only; no test logic changes.
